page.title: 程度と頻度をものさしで見る

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、barely・a little・fairly・pretty・quite・rather などで程度を目盛りのように表す方法と、never から always までの頻度を表す副詞の並びを扱う。頻度副詞は一般動詞の前、be動詞の後、助動詞・完了形では最初の助動詞の後に置くのが基本である。
grammarPoints: barely は必要量や知覚がほぼ限界であることを示す
a little は小さい程度、fairly・quite・pretty は中程度以上の程度を示す
rather は予想との差や話し手の意外感を伴うことがある
never・rarely・seldom・hardly ever・occasionally・sometimes・often・frequently・usually・always で頻度を段階化できる
頻度副詞は一般動詞の前、be動詞の後、最初の助動詞の後に置く
visualEvidence: 程度の低い側から高い側へ進むものさしが、barely・a little・fairly・pretty・quite・rather の強さを比較している
never から always へ上がる頻度メーターが、行為の起こる割合を連続的に示している
一般動詞・be動詞・助動詞の三つの文レールが、頻度副詞の基本位置を別々に示している
マスコットが副詞カードを動かし、修飾する語や頻度の目盛りに合わせて位置を変える図になっている
commonTraps: barely を「とても」の意味で使う
rarely・seldom・hardly ever に not を重ねる
頻度副詞を be動詞の前に置く
完了形や助動詞の後で頻度副詞を文末へ機械的に移す
pretty の会話的な程度用法と「かわいい」という形容詞を混同する
rather が単なる強調ではなく、意外感ややや否定的な評価を含み得る点を見落とす

questions.prompt: The serial number was ------- visible beneath the scratched coating.

choices.A: barely
choices.B: always
choices.C: quite
choices.D: frequently

questions.translationJa: 傷の付いた塗装の下に、製造番号がかろうじて見えました。
questions.explanationJa: barely visible は、見える程度がほぼ限界であることを表します。頻度を表す語や強い程度を表す quite は文脈に合いません。

questions.prompt: The downtown branch ------- closes before 6:00 P.M.; early closing is limited to major holidays.

choices.A: fairly
choices.B: rarely
choices.C: rare
choices.D: quite

questions.translationJa: 中心街の支店が午後6時前に閉まることはめったになく、早く閉まるのは主な祝日に限られます。
questions.explanationJa: early closing is limited to major holidays から頻度が非常に低いと分かるため、一般動詞 closes の前に rarely を置きます。

questions.prompt: The preliminary estimate is ------- accurate for planning purposes, although final costs may change.

choices.A: never
choices.B: bare
choices.C: fairly
choices.D: seldom

questions.translationJa: その概算は計画用途にはかなり正確ですが、最終費用は変わる可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: fairly accurate は「完全ではないが、かなり正確」を表します。although 以下の留保とも自然につながります。
questions.focus: fairly が表す中程度以上

questions.prompt: The lobby is ------- busy just after lunch, so schedule large deliveries for the morning.

choices.A: usual
choices.B: a little
choices.C: barely
choices.D: usually

questions.translationJa: ロビーは昼食直後にはたいてい混雑するので、大口配送は午前中に予定してください。
questions.explanationJa: 繰り返し起こる典型的な状況を述べるため usually が適切です。be動詞 is の後に頻度副詞を置きます。

questions.prompt: The two product codes are ------- different, so verify the final digit before shipping.

choices.A: a little
choices.B: always
choices.C: seldom
choices.D: frequency

questions.translationJa: 2つの商品コードは少しだけ異なるので、発送前に最後の数字を確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: a little different は差が小さいことを表します。頻度副詞では形容詞 different の程度を説明できません。

questions.prompt: The safety officer has ------- reminded contractors to wear eye protection in the workshop.

choices.A: oftenly
choices.B: often
choices.C: usual
choices.D: quite

questions.translationJa: 安全担当者は、作業場では保護眼鏡を着用するよう請負業者に何度も注意してきました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了では頻度副詞 often を最初の助動詞 has の後に置き、has often reminded とします。
questions.focus: 完了形での頻度副詞の位置

questions.prompt: The replacement chairs are ------- comfortable, although their armrests are narrow.

choices.A: quite often
choices.B: seldom
choices.C: quite
choices.D: bare

questions.translationJa: 交換用の椅子はかなり快適ですが、ひじ掛けは狭いです。
questions.explanationJa: quite comfortable は快適さの程度が高いことを示します。although 以下は完全な評価ではないことを補っています。

questions.prompt: The help desk ------- receives complaints about response time—perhaps once or twice a year.

choices.A: quite
choices.B: pretty
choices.C: always
choices.D: seldom

questions.translationJa: ヘルプデスクが対応時間について苦情を受けることはめったになく、年に1、2回ほどです。
questions.explanationJa: once or twice a year は低頻度を示すため seldom が適切です。一般動詞 receives の前に置きます。

questions.prompt: Attendance was ------- higher than the organizers had expected, so extra seats were added.

choices.A: rather
choices.B: never
choices.C: rarely
choices.D: a frequency

questions.translationJa: 参加者数は主催者の予想よりかなり多かったため、追加の席が用意されました。
questions.explanationJa: rather higher は、予想を上回ったという意外感を伴う程度表現です。than expected がそのニュアンスを支えます。

questions.prompt: The new booking interface is ------- intuitive, but first-time users may still need the short guide.

choices.A: hardly ever
choices.B: pretty
choices.C: prettily
choices.D: usual

questions.translationJa: 新しい予約画面はかなり直感的ですが、初めての利用者には短い案内がまだ必要かもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: ここでの pretty は会話的に「かなり」を表し、形容詞 intuitive を強めます。prettily は「きれいに」という副詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence describing the maintenance crew’s routine.

choices.A: The maintenance crew checks usually the emergency exits before opening.
choices.B: The maintenance crew is usually check the emergency exits before opening.
choices.C: The maintenance crew usually checks the emergency exits before opening.
choices.D: The maintenance crew usual checks the emergency exits before opening.

questions.translationJa: 保守担当は通常、営業開始前に非常口を確認します。
questions.explanationJa: 一般動詞 checks を修飾する頻度副詞 usually は、その直前に置くのが基本です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about elevator congestion in the morning.

choices.A: The elevators rarely are crowded before 7:00 A.M.
choices.B: The elevators are rare crowded before 7:00 A.M.
choices.C: The elevators are crowded rarely before 7:00 A.M.
choices.D: The elevators are rarely crowded before 7:00 A.M.

questions.translationJa: 午前7時前にエレベーターが混雑することはめったにありません。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞を含む文では頻度副詞 rarely を be動詞 are の後に置きます。rare は形容詞なのでこの位置では使えません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing the supplier’s delivery history.

choices.A: The supplier has often delivered replacement parts ahead of schedule.
choices.B: The supplier often has delivered replacement parts ahead of schedule.
choices.C: The supplier has delivered often replacement parts ahead of schedule.
choices.D: The supplier has often delivers replacement parts ahead of schedule.

questions.translationJa: その仕入先は交換部品を予定より早く納入することがよくあります。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了では often を最初の助動詞 has の後に置き、過去分詞 delivered を続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence evaluating the revised explanation.

choices.A: The revised explanation is fair clear for a first draft.
choices.B: The revised explanation is fairly clear for a first draft.
choices.C: The revised explanation fairly is clear for a first draft.
choices.D: The revised explanation is clarity fairly for a first draft.

questions.translationJa: 改訂された説明は初稿としてはかなり明確です。
questions.explanationJa: fairly は程度副詞として形容詞 clear の直前に置きます。fair は形容詞で意味も異なります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the sound during the online meeting.

choices.A: We barely could heard the remote presenter during the connection problem.
choices.B: We could bare hear the remote presenter during the connection problem.
choices.C: We could barely hear the remote presenter during the connection problem.
choices.D: We could barely heard the remote presenter during the connection problem.

questions.translationJa: 接続障害の間、遠隔の発表者の声はかろうじて聞こえる程度でした。
questions.explanationJa: 助動詞 could の後は動詞原形 hear を置き、barely を could と hear の間に置いて聞こえる程度の低さを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence giving a strong but not absolute evaluation of the layout.

choices.A: The new filing layout is quite practically for a small office.
choices.B: The new filing layout quite is practical for a small office.
choices.C: The new filing layout is a quite practical for a small office.
choices.D: The new filing layout is quite practical for a small office.

questions.translationJa: 新しいファイル配置は小規模な事務所にはかなり実用的です。
questions.explanationJa: quite は形容詞 practical の直前に置く程度副詞です。補語には副詞 practically ではなく形容詞が必要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an occasional customer-service issue.

choices.A: The support team occasionally receives duplicate requests from the same account.
choices.B: The support team receives occasionally duplicate requests from the same account.
choices.C: The support team is occasionally receive duplicate requests from the same account.
choices.D: The support team occasional receives duplicate requests from the same account.

questions.translationJa: サポートチームは時折、同じアカウントから重複した依頼を受け取ります。
questions.explanationJa: occasionally は一般動詞 receives の前に置きます。occasional は形容詞なので動詞を修飾できません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence making a mild criticism of a presentation.

choices.A: The presentation was little a too long for the scheduled time slot.
choices.B: The presentation was a little too long for the scheduled time slot.
choices.C: The presentation a little was too long for the scheduled time slot.
choices.D: The presentation was a little too length for the scheduled time slot.

questions.translationJa: その発表は予定された時間枠には少し長すぎました。
questions.explanationJa: a little は too long 全体の程度を和らげ、「少し長すぎた」という控えめな評価を作ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the store’s punctual opening record.

choices.A: The store always almost opens at exactly 9:00 A.M.
choices.B: The store opens almost always at exactly 9:00 A.M.
choices.C: The store almost always opens at exactly 9:00 A.M.
choices.D: The store is almost always open at exactly 9:00 A.M. every opens.

questions.translationJa: その店はほぼいつも午前9時ちょうどに開店します。
questions.explanationJa: almost always は一まとまりで一般動詞 opens の前に置き、100パーセントではない高頻度を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about system availability.

choices.A: The reservation system hardly ever is unavailable during business hours.
choices.B: The reservation system is not hardly ever unavailable during business hours.
choices.C: The reservation system is hardly unavailable ever during business hours.
choices.D: The reservation system is hardly ever unavailable during business hours.

questions.translationJa: 予約システムが営業時間中に利用できなくなることはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞 is の後に hardly ever を置きます。hardly ever 自体が低頻度を表すので not は重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The battery had barely enough power to complete the test.”

choices.A: The battery had only just enough power for the test to finish.
choices.B: The battery had far more power than the test required.
choices.C: The battery was never used during the test.
choices.D: The test ended before any battery power was needed.

questions.translationJa: そのバッテリーには試験を完了できるぎりぎりの電力しかありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: barely enough は「必要量をわずかに満たす、ぎりぎり足りる」という意味です。only just enough が同じ限界感を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Shipments from this vendor are seldom delayed.”

choices.A: Every shipment from this vendor is delayed.
choices.B: Shipments from this vendor are not often late.
choices.C: This vendor delays shipments on purpose.
choices.D: The vendor has stopped making shipments.

questions.translationJa: この仕入先からの荷物が遅れることはめったにありません。
questions.explanationJa: seldom は低い頻度を表し、not often とほぼ同じ意味です。never ほど完全なゼロではありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The prototype is fairly reliable.”

choices.A: The prototype fails every time it is used.
choices.B: The prototype is absolutely flawless.
choices.C: The prototype is reasonably dependable, though not necessarily perfect.
choices.D: The prototype has not yet been evaluated.

questions.translationJa: その試作品はかなり信頼できます。
questions.explanationJa: fairly reliable は「十分に、かなり信頼できる」が、完全無欠とまでは述べない表現です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “A receptionist is always available during office hours.”

choices.A: A receptionist is available only before the office opens.
choices.B: A receptionist is rarely at the front desk.
choices.C: The office has no receptionist during working hours.
choices.D: A receptionist can be reached at any time while the office is open.

questions.translationJa: 営業時間中はいつでも受付担当者が対応できます。
questions.explanationJa: always available during office hours は、営業中のどの時点でも対応可能であることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The approval process is rather complicated.”

choices.A: The approval process is somewhat more complex than one might expect.
choices.B: The approval process is perfectly simple.
choices.C: The approval process is used only on rare occasions.
choices.D: The approval process has already been canceled.

questions.translationJa: 承認手続きは思ったよりやや複雑です。
questions.explanationJa: rather complicated は、単に程度を示すだけでなく、予想以上に複雑だという話し手の評価を含み得ます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The annual fee is a little expensive for small businesses.”

choices.A: The annual fee is completely unaffordable for every company.
choices.B: The annual fee is slightly costly for small businesses.
choices.C: Small businesses never pay an annual fee.
choices.D: The fee becomes lower every year.

questions.translationJa: その年会費は小規模事業者には少し高めです。
questions.explanationJa: a little expensive は「少し高い」を表し、slightly costly が同じ軽い程度を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The online catalog is frequently updated.”

choices.A: The online catalog is never revised.
choices.B: The catalog was updated only once when it launched.
choices.C: Changes are made to the online catalog many times.
choices.D: The online catalog is difficult to access.

questions.translationJa: オンラインカタログは頻繁に更新されます。
questions.explanationJa: frequently は「高い頻度で、何度も」を表します。many times がその頻度を言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The conference room is hardly ever empty in the afternoon.”

choices.A: The conference room is empty every afternoon.
choices.B: The room is available only for conferences in the morning.
choices.C: No one is allowed to enter the room after noon.
choices.D: The conference room is almost always occupied in the afternoon.

questions.translationJa: 午後にその会議室が空いていることはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: hardly ever empty は「空である頻度がほぼゼロ」で、反対の状態を用いた almost always occupied と同じ内容です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The revised form is pretty straightforward.”

choices.A: The revised form is quite easy to understand.
choices.B: The revised form looks attractive but is impossible to use.
choices.C: The form requires a completely new approval process.
choices.D: The revised form is rarely distributed.

questions.translationJa: 改訂された用紙はかなり分かりやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: 程度副詞 pretty はここでは「かなり」を表し、quite easy to understand と言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The branch usually opens on Saturdays.”

choices.A: The branch never operates on a Saturday.
choices.B: The branch opens on most Saturdays, but not necessarily every one.
choices.C: The branch is required to open every Saturday without exception.
choices.D: Saturday is the only day the branch remains closed.

questions.translationJa: その支店はたいてい土曜日に営業します。
questions.explanationJa: usually は「ほとんどの場合」を表しますが、always のように例外がないとは限りません。
questions.focus: usually と always の違い

questions.prompt: Last quarter, the service center handled more than 8,000 calls. Only three callers submitted formal complaints. -------

choices.A: The service center always receives formal complaints.
choices.B: The service center is rather a formal complaint.
choices.C: The service center rarely receives formal complaints.
choices.D: The service center receives complaints quite every call.

questions.translationJa: 前四半期、サービスセンターは8,000件を超える電話に対応しましたが、正式な苦情は3件だけでした。サービスセンターが正式な苦情を受けることはめったにありません。
questions.explanationJa: 8,000件中3件という非常に低い頻度をまとめるため rarely が最適です。
questions.focus: 数値から rarely を判断

questions.prompt: The printed map is accurate, but the north arrow is slightly off center. The designer can fix it in a few minutes. -------

choices.A: The map is always impossible to use.
choices.B: The map barely needs a complete redesign.
choices.C: The map is frequently inaccurate in every section.
choices.D: The map needs a little adjustment.

questions.translationJa: 印刷された地図は正確ですが、北を示す矢印が少し中心からずれています。デザイナーは数分で直せます。地図には少し調整が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 問題が小さく短時間で直せるため、小さい程度を表す a little adjustment が文脈に合います。
questions.focus: a little で小さな程度を表す

questions.prompt: The customer counter is staffed from 8:30 A.M. to 5:30 P.M. without any gaps in the schedule. -------

choices.A: An employee is always present during those hours.
choices.B: An employee present always is during those hours.
choices.C: An employee is seldom present during those hours.
choices.D: An employee is a little present during those hours.

questions.translationJa: 顧客窓口には午前8時30分から午後5時30分まで途切れなく担当者が配置されています。その時間帯は常に従業員がいます。
questions.explanationJa: without any gaps は例外なく配置されていることを示します。be動詞 is の後に always を置く文が正しいです。

questions.prompt: The inspection tablet showed 4 percent battery power when the final checklist began. It shut down seconds after the last item was saved. -------

choices.A: The tablet was quite fully charged throughout the inspection.
choices.B: The tablet had barely enough power to finish the inspection.
choices.C: The tablet always had unlimited battery power.
choices.D: The tablet seldom used any power during the inspection.

questions.translationJa: 最終チェックリストを始めたとき、検査用タブレットの充電は4パーセントでした。最後の項目を保存して数秒後に停止しました。タブレットには検査を終えるぎりぎりの電力しかありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 完了直後に停止したため、必要量をわずかに満たしたことを表す barely enough が適切です。

questions.prompt: The software team releases small security patches several times each month. Users are advised to enable automatic installation. -------

choices.A: The application is never updated.
choices.B: The application is rather an update.
choices.C: The application is frequently updated.
choices.D: The application is barely update several months.

questions.translationJa: ソフトウェアチームは毎月数回、小規模なセキュリティ修正を公開します。自動インストールを有効にすることが推奨されています。そのアプリは頻繁に更新されます。
questions.explanationJa: several times each month は高頻度を表すため frequently updated が自然な要約です。
questions.focus: 頻度句から frequently を選ぶ

questions.prompt: The training room felt colder than anyone expected, even though the thermostat showed a normal setting. -------

choices.A: The room was never temperature.
choices.B: The room was a little always.
choices.C: The room was hardly ever a thermostat.
choices.D: The room was rather chilly.

questions.translationJa: 研修室は、温度設定が正常だったにもかかわらず、皆の予想より寒く感じられました。部屋は思ったよりかなり肌寒かったです。
questions.explanationJa: than anyone expected という意外感があるため rather chilly が適切です。

questions.prompt: In five years, weather has forced the company to cancel only one outdoor event. -------

choices.A: Outdoor events are hardly ever canceled.
choices.B: Outdoor events are always canceled.
choices.C: Outdoor events cancel hardly themselves.
choices.D: Outdoor events are quite cancellation.

questions.translationJa: 5年間で、天候のために屋外イベントを中止したのは1回だけです。屋外イベントが中止されることはほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: 5年間で1回という極めて低い頻度は hardly ever で表せます。be動詞の後に置きます。

questions.prompt: Survey participants repeatedly praised the new help page for its clear examples and short steps. -------

choices.A: The help page often has described as easy to use.
choices.B: The help page has often been described as easy to use.
choices.C: The help page has been described often easy to use.
choices.D: The help page has often described easy to use.

questions.translationJa: 調査参加者は、明確な例と短い手順を理由に新しいヘルプページを繰り返し高く評価しました。そのページは使いやすいと何度も評されています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了受動態では、頻度副詞 often を最初の助動詞 has の後に置き、has often been described とします。
questions.focus: 完了受動態での often の位置

questions.prompt: The revised warranty covers parts, labor, shipping, and on-site support for three years. -------

choices.A: The coverage is barely any coverage at all.
choices.B: The coverage is never extensive every year.
choices.C: The coverage is quite extensive.
choices.D: The coverage extensive quite is.

questions.translationJa: 改訂された保証は部品、作業費、配送、現地支援を3年間カバーします。保証範囲はかなり広いです。
questions.explanationJa: 複数の項目を長期間カバーしているため、程度の高さを示す quite extensive が文脈に合います。
questions.focus: quite で高い程度を表す

questions.prompt: The warehouse normally dispatches orders by 4:00 P.M. On rare inspection days, dispatch may occur later. -------

choices.A: Orders are always dispatched after 4:00 P.M.
choices.B: Orders usually are dispatch by 4:00 P.M.
choices.C: Orders are usual dispatched by 4:00 P.M.
choices.D: Orders are usually dispatched by 4:00 P.M.

questions.translationJa: 倉庫では通常、午後4時までに注文を発送します。まれに検査日には遅くなることがあります。注文はたいてい午後4時までに発送されます。
questions.explanationJa: normally と rare exceptions から usually が適切です。受動態では be動詞 are の後に usually を置きます。
questions.focus: 受動態での usually の位置
